{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
deduplicated = data.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Filter to only the treatment arm
treatment_arm = deduplicated[deduplicated['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute the fraction of patients who responded
fraction_responded = treatment_arm['responded'].mean()

# Print only the fraction, not intermediate counts
print(fraction_responded)"}
